label: shadcn/ui + Tailwind
description: Copy-in Base UI primitives styled with Tailwind.

vars.name: shadcn/ui + Tailwind

context: UI primitives are shadcn components copied into `<% ui-kit.component_root %>` — they are project source, not a dependency
rules: Add a primitive with `<% ui-kit.add_cmd %>` rather than hand-writing it, then edit the copied file freely

scaffold.$comment: Verified on both Next.js and React (Vite): `shadcn init -d -y` writes components.json and src/lib/utils.ts. On Vite this depends on react-vite having already copied its config in — shadcn's file resolver needs baseUrl+paths in the ROOT tsconfig.json (or it writes to a literal @/ directory) plus the Vite `@` alias and Tailwind, all of which react-vite stages before this command runs. The -d flag is load-bearing — shadcn 4.x added an interactive component-library picker that -y alone does NOT skip, so without -d this command blocks forever waiting on stdin. The second command re-installs base-nova's runtime deps with --prefix: shadcn init shells out to `npm install` with cwd = apps/web, which SILENTLY no-ops when a backend has made apps/web an npm workspace (npm filters to a phantom workspace named 'web'); --prefix installs into apps/web directly. This list tracks the base-nova preset — re-check it if shadcn's default style changes.

commands.run: npm --prefix <% frontend.app_dir %> install @base-ui/react class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge tw-animate-css shadcn @fontsource-variable/geist lucide-react
